text: Replaced the closed FieldRole taxonomy with open ValueSemantics[A, Sem] evidence. Continuous construction derives from LinearInterpolable[A]; categorical construction preserves arbitrary exact A; reference linear sampling requires LinearSampling[A, Sem], while nearest is value-preserving. Runtime-loaded axes remain a runtime ordered list: TimeSeriesView and ComponentAxisView have private constructors, checked factories reject missing/ambiguous kinds, and both retain the original Sampled/NDArray by reference. Future mapValues/zipWith must require explicit target semantics rather than infer them.
